workflow.proposedTitle: Review System Data candidates before trusting a deletion recommendation
workflow.primaryIntent: Help Mac owners distinguish a large storage candidate from permission to delete it, using FreeUpMyMac's Scan/Browse/Smart Check workflow as a documented example.
outline: Lead with review and backups, not a 30 GB target or guaranteed 100 GB recovery
Top visual: cleared official System Junk view; vendor numbers explicitly not our measurements
Separate storage scan from server-assisted file advice; inspect whether a path/name is sensitive before requesting Smart Check
Record ownership, purpose, backup, rebuild/download cost, cleanup method and post-action free-space observation; do not execute cleanup for the article
Later visual: disclosed Breathing Room Space example preview; bounded choice for storage exploration and source-implemented ongoing monitoring
Explain current purchase/licence and preview caveats before any recommendation
workflow.interactionPass: Propose a non-mutating decision checklist: ownership known? backup verified? rebuild cost understood? exact action/method reviewed? metadata sharing acceptable? Any unknown stops the deletion recommendation. No invented app UI or forced code sample.
workflow.distinctness: Workflow is file-level review and Smart Check data disclosure; comparison is product selection. No separate alternatives doorway.
